breaks.title: Breaks & Eye Care
breaks.idleNote: Only counts while you are at the computer. The timer pauses (but does not reset) after a minute without keyboard or mouse input; being away for more than 5 minutes counts as a break.
breaks.nightHint: Reduces blue light in the evening with a 30-minute fade at the start and end.
breaks.nightUnsupported: Night mode is not available in this session. On Linux it only works in X11 sessions, not in Wayland.
breaks.previewing: The preview lasts a few seconds.
breaks.privacy: Only total time is stored; which programs you use is never recorded.
breaks.breakTip: Look away from the screen at something in the distance.

clipboard.title: Clipboard History
clipboard.label: Category / Tags
clipboard.pausedNote: Recording is paused; copied items are not added to the history.
clipboard.shortcutFailed: The shortcut could not be registered; another program may be using it. Pick a different one in settings.
clipboard.autoPaste: Paste automatically when picking an item in the popup
clipboard.ignoredHint: One program per line, by its file name (e.g. keepassxc; .exe is optional). Anything copied from them is never saved. On Windows and macOS, copies that password managers mark as sensitive are also skipped automatically. Program detection does not work in Wayland sessions.

renamer.title: Batch Renamer
renamer.drop: Drag and drop files or folders here
renamer.blocked: There are conflicting or invalid names; fix them first.
renamer.undone: {n} files restored to their old names.

organizer.title: File Organizer
organizer.byDate: Also split by month under each type (YYYY-MM)
organizer.previewHint: Review the list below before moving. Uncheck any file you want to leave alone.
organizer.trash: Send {n} selected files to the Recycle Bin
organizer.trashConfirm: {n} files will be sent to the Recycle Bin. You can restore them from there.
organizer.trashed: {n} files sent to the Recycle Bin.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autostart: Start automatically when the computer starts
settings.autostartHint: The app starts quietly in the system tray.
settings.privacy: All your data stays on this computer. There is no telemetry, and no internet connection is used unless you turn on update checking.
settings.updatesAuto: Check for updates when the app starts
settings.updatesHint: While this is off the app never connects to the internet. While it is on, only the latest version number is requested from GitHub; no data is sent.
settings.updatesManual: On this system the app cannot install itself; download and install the new package.
settings.updatesToast: New version available: {version}. You can install it from Settings.
